items.note: S2.4.1 restates Lemma lem:scalar-motifs faithfully (eight rows of copy/gather/scatter/side injection, y_S += x_S for arbitrary scratch, three stages give (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring scratch). The proof (net change (JV+RG)x, stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x)) is not reconstructed; S2.4.3.1 only alludes to the coefficient cancellation, and h=100, N, m and the wire counts are absent.

The route matches 804-825: common frame commutes with pointwise gate, invariant carried to sinks, operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, intermediate frames free. The route operator in S2.4.2.2 drops the scalar sign epsilon_w of 820-822, which matters for the complex network.

Triple-indicator orthogonality, comparable labels, the only decreasing edges at center 3->4 losing h, L=Ich, sum = Wm-2N+2L and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are all stated correctly. The derivation (label table eq:motif-labels, residual table, telescoping with source dimensions N and sink dimensions Wm-N) is not shown; S2.4.3.2 just quotes the lemma.

s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m and the endpoint identity I_m are stated; the rank sum is derived as in 1158-1167 (rank of P_V-P_U equals dim change, N rank-one source exceptions, deficit N-2L_b). The endpoint computation P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m, the assignment of P_U to gates, and the shear frames Phi_M that make it H<-H+D are missing.

S2.4.3.5 correctly gives one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, but the phase frames C_U=H^{(m)} diag(i^{q_U}) H^{(m)} are never defined, and the conclusion that after diagonal corrections every role gets C^{(x)m} is missing. The weight-additivity proof is not reconstructed.

L/N<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, s_c<W_c m, deficits above 20*2^{-50}, log m<20, and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50} with s/W<m^tau are all stated. The exact eta values and the inequality m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta) are not written out, so this is a statement chain rather than a derivation.

S2.2 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S2.3 gives the controlled shift and its split-and-merge mechanism (577-581), but its claim leaves out the requirement that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time (this appears only in the quote) and omits the fixed rational unit multiplications.

The route matches 1425-1446: factor A=E_1 Pi E_2, do the triangular parts as controlled shifts in tape order, and implement each one of Pi by D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j, for exactly a interchanges. The statement omits that the arithmetic is over Z/q^b for a fixed prime q avoiding the denominators, and the elimination proof of the factorization is not given.

Row split into W role streams of volume V/W, three shears with only the middle on the network, exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), geometric sum in both cases of a, and the O(V) parking schedule all match. Missing: the frames Phi_M and the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, i.e. H<-H+D on every row, plus the merge that undoes rho (1504-1533).

Statement matches Lemma lem:chunk-swap. The derivation follows 1650-1734: the top rho digits become the row field at cost O(V rho), rows are padded to a multiple of W^k, the remaining width is split in base m and given to the power-width interchange for O(Ve^tau), and binary ranges are padded to [q^e].

C identities, the GL(m,F_2) change of basis moving residual vectors to slots, s_c forward children on e/m axes with the inverse-child identity, and H_0^{(x)D}=b^D S_D C^{(x)D} S_D all match 1822-1931. The basis changes are reduced to fixed row additions via S2.6.2.

The eight parity operations, the cyclic-shift implementation agreeing off a bad set with |B|<=delta_bad M, and the repair by extraction and radix sort follow the paper. The fact that T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes B (2107-2114) is left implicit, and S2.6.2.4 says 'remaining records' where the paper extracts the records of B.

Rows from the first q_0 chunks, the u=Wg+w split giving V/W children, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e) below d^beta, internal O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}) all match.

The claim and the guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) with one final truncation (error < sqrt2 2^{-p}) are stated. The arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E behind the guard width (2479-2559) is missing, as is the uniformity check on the packed calls (2696-2735).

Character cancellation, the DIF step, bit-reversed storage, the reverse procedure computing F^+B^{-1} and the grouped rounds follow the paper. The layout L (prefix-slot moves, chunk exchanges putting each round's bits at a common offset) and its cost are only stated in S3.2, not derived.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<2^{3p}<B_0/2, centered residues with a 0/1 carry, and reduction mod y^r+1 match 3233-3368.

The method (two forward transforms in a common order, pointwise signed-packed products, opposite transform, scale by M) and the normalization F^-(f*g)=M(F^-f)(F^-g), F^+F^-=I/M match 3414-3430. The error accumulation to sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p} is not derived.

P_sF_s=2^{2alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA, the error and cost of the approximations, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, and the cost of axis exposure are stated correctly. The construction of the Gaussian contractions is not shown.
Both eq:permuted-chirp and eq:source-permutation-cancel are stated with the correct chirp. Only the remark that a coordinate permutation commutes with pointwise products is given toward the proof.

Fixed rationals, sizes, the prime interval and T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p follow the paper's order. eta=1/(4d) and alpha=ceil((12d^2b)^{1/4}) are never defined, although they drive the prime interval and alpha^4 theta>p. delta and kappa are also omitted from S5.1.1.
Isomorphism via order-S image, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum a_jP_j, and the cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) through controlled shifts and O(d^2) axis moves all match.

The isometric isomorphism Theta and the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j match 4303-4319. The resulting identity M_C(f,g)=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T, which links it to the ring convolution, and the twist error bounds are missing.
Chirp transform, source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, and the six steps with the two occurrences of S follow 4434-4544.

The norm bound .26, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28 2^gamma T^2L, the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding and carries are correct. The source-error chain (E_ring, chirp error, E_s=9 2^gamma TL) is skipped and E_s is never defined.
All seven table rows with their powers, min g_i=g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, the log-power absorption and the final O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) match.
S1 recalls the Schonhage-Strassen conjecture and the HvdH O(n log n) bound. It never formulates the eventual lower bound or that one machine with liminf T/(n lg n)=0 refutes it.

errors.says: A route from role w to rho(w) applies D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} to its array.
errors.paper: The route applies epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, with the scalar sign of the signed role permutation; the complex network has sign -1 on Y_a -> X_a.

errors.says: The fixed exchange network has W wires of rank-m labels.
errors.paper: Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of the m-dimensional space F^{(x)3} of varying dimension (0 at scratch sources, U_a of dimension 1, up to F); m is the ambient dimension, so Wm is the trivial bound.

errors.says: Each edge of the complex network factors into one two-point kernel C=aI+bX per residual basis vector.
errors.paper: Each edge factors into one translation kernel aI+bX_v, or its inverse, per orthonormal residual vector v; these become coordinate kernels C^{+-1} only after conjugation by P_M.

errors.says: The remaining records are extracted, given their destination ranks, sorted and reinserted.
errors.paper: Only the records at exceptional addresses in B are extracted; T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes B, so their destination keys are the ranks of the marked holes.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: rank-saving networks, then chunk interchange and simultaneous butterfly layers, then synthetic transforms and ring convolution, then resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation, then the CRT map and twist, then the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table. Every link from s<Wm to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) is present. It thins at the interfaces. The shear frames Phi_M, which turn the endpoint identity I_m into H<-H+D on every role, are never given. The complex endpoint C^{(x)m} and the phase frames C_U are not defined. Resampling, convolution error and the source-error chain are stated rather than derived.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) that restores every scratch wire is stated. h=100, the indexing of data pairs by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are absent, and S2.4.3 only mentions three-element subsets in passing.
Common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge pays only D_vD_u^{-1}. The route sign epsilon_w is omitted.

Nondegenerate subspace labels of F^{(x)3} built from triple indicators, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges at center wires 3->4 each losing h are all present. Dimension m is implicit through the bound Wm.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, plus the N negative source projections whose first edge has rank one, as at 1158-1165.
Sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539 are below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, and s<Wm for both networks.

S2.4.3.4 states that the endpoint matrices differ by I_m on every input role. The plan never gives the frames Phi_M:(H,D)->(H+MD,D) or explains that this identity makes the bit network apply H<-H+D on every role; S2.4.6.2 only asserts that the middle shear uses the network. Rated conservatively.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with lower triangular factors, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) by the three-update trick, and s recursive calls per node in total.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from deficits above 20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan carries the central saving clearly from frames through labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget, the strict deficit, shears as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}; seven of nine steps are reconstructed. It is thin at the start, with no h=100, N or m for the fixed network. It also leaves out the shear frames Phi_M, so the endpoint identity I_m is never connected to the network applying H<-H+D on every role.
